verdicts.photo_observation: This is an upgrade project connecting to an existing AJB, so DC-side routing is not re-photographed. The AC/LA routing that is shown is consistent: the Cable Routing render (p.9) traces a purple AC line from the new panels to the existing AJB with the caption 'AC cable is already available on site'; the Earthing Routing render (p.11) traces an orange LA cable and green DC-earthing line from the roof LA point down to an 'LA Pit'; real photos on p.12 show the orange LA route physically marked running down the exterior wall from roof to ground, ending at the 'LA Pit' photo on p.13 and a separately marked 'AC Earth Pit' on p.14. These segments connect end-to-end without orphan markers. However, no photo documents the actual DC cable run from panels to inverter, or the ACDB/inverter equipment itself, since those are pre-existing and unchanged in this upgrade.
verdicts.rationale: The earthing/LA routing segment is fully and consistently traced from roof to pit across diagram and real photos, but the DC panel-to-inverter and inverter-to-ACDB legs are not photographed at all in this upgrade-project report, so full end-to-end continuity cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
